posts.author: iamsillydeveloper
posts.body: If I want  to distribute a game made with RPG maker MV and used it's in game assets (with my edits in it), am I suppoed to write credits somewhere else as well? I left the sign that says powered by RPG maker at the start and I saw a html file (named credits) that was automatized when I finished game.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Did you look at that credits.html file? Those are the software components that RPG Maker needs to credit. It doesn't have any way of knowing who made any of the artwork etc. that you're using in the game.
Yes, you must credit everyone whose work you use, in the way they specify.
Have you ever played a video game? Seen the credits list at the end? You can do that, you can make a document in your game folder, use a plugin that comes up when you Google it to add it to your title screen, etc.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
EULA is here, article 3 of game distribution terms is what you want.
EULA | RPG Maker | Make A Game!
Read the engaging End User License Agreement for RPG Maker VX Ace and the Runtime Package
www.rpgmakerweb.com
Upon distribution, etc. of the User Game, the User shall provide the following notifications or declarations to users of User Games.
1. Clearly indicate in the attached documentation (in the event there is no attached documentation, in the help file or in a location readily visible to the user of the User Game. The same shall apply hereafter) that the User Game was created using the Software.
2. The attached documentation shall have the following Statement of Rights.
● Statement of Rights: “©2015 GOTCHA GOTCHA GAMES/YOJI OJIMA”
3. Acts where the Company’s program and/or Company Materials are extracted from the User Game and distributed, etc. are prohibited, regardless of whether for fee or gratis.
4. Acts where the Company’s program and/or Company Materials are extracted from the User Game and modified are prohibited.
5. Acts where Company Materials are extracted from the User Game and used for self-authored games are prohibited, whether for fee or gratis.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
It means you have to list ©2015 GOTCHA GOTCHA GAMES/YOJI OJIMA in either an attached document or help file somewhere in your download folder, or somewhere visible like a credit screen, credit roll, etc. Somewhere that is not completely hidden away.
3-5 mean the software and assets themselves cannot be extractable from the download of your game by your players.
